verdict.rationale: Capacities' own docs explicitly describe the mobile app as a 'companion to desktop for day-to-day work' limited to 'search and capture on the go,' contradicting the story's demand for a full-featured app with the whole knowledge base including linking. missing for 10: evidence of full linking/graph/backlinks/templates support on mobile, independent hands-on reviews of the iOS/Android apps, any confirmation of feature parity rather than companion-app framing.
